name: Voltage District Club Collar
description:
A wide, rigid collar made from electroluminescent panels and chrome hardware, worn tight around the neck as a fashion statement in GLMZ's Voltage District club scene. The collar pulses with programmed light patterns and can display text messages or simple animations across its surface. Some feature integrated shock modules that deliver a mild jolt at the wearer's command — a club-scene dare that functions as social currency.

The Voltage Collar walks the line between fashion and self-imposed restraint. In a scene that values extremity, wearing a collar signals willingness to push boundaries — the tighter and more visible, the more committed the wearer.
functionality: Light display, text messaging, optional electrical stimulation
what_it_says: You wear your willingness to go further than everyone else around your throat.
story_hooks: A Voltage Collar's shock module is found modified to deliver lethal voltage — what looked like a fashion accessory at the club was a weapon waiting to be activated.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A striking rigid collar that frames the neck like a technological choker, commanding immediate attention. The wide, sculptural silhouette creates a bold graphic presence against the body. On-wearer: dramatic, assertive, almost ceremonial; off-wearer: resembles a sleek chrome cage or restraint device.
physical_description.fit: Tight and snug around the neck, non-adjustable tension that signals commitment and risk-taking. The rigidity prevents slouching or casual positioning—the wearer must carry it with intention.
physical_description.primary_material: Electroluminescent panel arrays mounted in milled chrome or brushed titanium frames; internal circuitry and capacitor clusters visible through translucent panel edges
physical_description.texture: Smooth, cool glass-like electroluminescent surface contrasting with brushed metal hardware; subtle grid pattern from pixel arrays visible when inactive
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: deep matte black or gun-metal grey frame with cyan, violet, or hot pink electroluminescent panels that pulse and shift. Accent chrome or polished titanium hardware catches environmental light.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap system at rear nape for quick release, or friction-fit magnetic coupling that requires deliberate engagement
distinctive_features: Programmable electroluminescent text/animation display across front panels
Optional integrated micro-shock module (variable intensity, user-controlled via subdermal haptic interface or external key-fob)
Micro-ports for message relay and custom firmware uploads
Heat-dispersal vents drilled into lower panels to prevent neck irritation from prolonged wear
Maker's mark or crew tag etched into chrome housings (Voltage District artisan customization)
LED feedback indicator showing charge status and shock readiness
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 cultural statement; expensive enough to signal investment in scene identity, not so expensive as to be corpo-exclusive. Street-origin status symbol.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearer is embedded in GLMZ Voltage District nightlife, likely augmented, willing to perform social risk, seeks visibility and transgression. Signals belonging to underground youth culture, club credibility, and personal agency through self-imposed constraint.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; develops micro-scratches on chrome from club friction and sweat exposure. Electroluminescent panels may show dead pixels from heavy use. Often customized with stickers, etchings, or modded firmware.
